title: Bounded worker pool rejects on full and drains on shutdown
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the sentinel puts blocking on a full queue. They cannot: sentinels are only enqueued after queue.join() shows every accepted job finished (so the queue is empty), and in the wait=False path that whole stop sequence runs on a background daemon thread, so shutdown itself never blocks on it.
